_schema_note: Append-only. A decision's identity is the (category, subject) pair; to change a decision, APPEND a new entry with the identical category+subject and move the old choice into options_considered with rejected_because explaining the change. Never edit or delete old entries.

decisions.category: pipeline_selection | explainer_shape | voice_selection | music_selection | output_profile | approval_gates | delivery_packaging
decisions.subject: <stable human-readable subject, e.g. 'Explainer shape'>
decisions.selected: <the choice, e.g. 'solution preview (UI tour)' or 'concept explainer (step diagrams)'>
decisions.approved_by: <optional: 'user brief' when the user's request fixed this>
